config.intro: A selection of local and international brands I have collaborated with as art director, graphic designer and creative lead.
Five practices, one system. Each engagement is built around what the brand needs to be remembered for.
The working method proposed for each engagement — four phases, scaled to the project.
Campaigns, key visuals and content systems directed for brands in Mozambique and beyond.
Tell me about your project. I respond to every message within 48 hours with an initial process proposal.

paragraphs: Based in the Mozambican creative ecosystem, I combine strategy, visual identity, campaign direction, communication systems, typography, digital content, motion and AI tools into one practice.
On-site in Maputo and remote worldwide, available for international projects. Agency and corporate experience across identity, advertising, digital content, institutional communication and print.

profile_content.name: Edmundo Kutuzov
profile_content.intro: I'm Edmundo Kutuzov, an art director from Maputo operating globally, building brand systems that earn attention rather than beg for it. 30+ brands. One obsession: work that refuses to be ignored.
profile_content.headline: I make ideas stop, take notice, stay in memory, and act.

experience_items.description: Directing high-visibility visual campaigns, motion rollouts and multichannel creative systems for enterprise accounts in Mozambique.
Leading campaign concepts and key visuals for agency clients across automotive, finance and consumer brands.
Building identity and communication pieces with typographic rigour for corporate and institutional accounts.
Running social presence and in-house campaign communication for an insurance brand.
Advertising, print, digital content and institutional communication — the foundation years.

principles.title: Clarity
principles.description: Every element must earn its place. Noise is the enemy of memory.

principles.title: Rhythm
principles.description: Pacing dictates attention. Contrast creates engagement.

principles.title: Precision
principles.description: Execution defines positioning. God is in the details.

principles.title: Memory
principles.description: Aesthetic survival requires a distinct point of view.

services.line: Strategic brand marks, typography systems & identity architecture.
services.title: Visual Identity
services.description: Turning strategic brand intent into a recognisable visual form. A complete visual grammar — logo systems, proprietary type pairings, colour scales and identity manuals built to last.

services.line: Campaign conception, visual storytelling & photography direction.
services.title: Art Direction
services.description: Defining the visual dimension of campaigns and brand narratives. Photography direction, set styling, cinematic colour grading and commercial rollout systems for national and global markets.

services.line: Tactile publications, large-format OOH & packaging design.
services.title: Editorial & Print
services.description: Editorial compositions, annual reports, large-format billboards, product packaging and print production oversight — with typographic rigour from screen to press.

services.line: Social-first content engines, motion assets & digital systems.
services.title: Digital Design
services.description: Modular digital ecosystems that keep a brand present and in rhythm. Social publishing systems, UI/UX aesthetics, digital campaign kits, motion graphics and interactive web interfaces.

services.line: Generative pipelines directed with an art director's eye.
services.title: AI Creative Direction
services.description: Using AI as a production instrument, not a shortcut — concept exploration, image synthesis, retouching and content at scale, always held to the brand system and human judgement.
